description: This file defines the VoiceWakePreferences enum in Swift that manages preferences related to voice wake trigger words, including loading, saving, sanitizing, and decoding trigger words from JSON payloads and user defaults.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: String)
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string payload into an array of trigger words, returning nil if decoding fails.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggers(from: Data)
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into an array of trigger words.

methods.name: loadTriggerWords(defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Loads trigger words from UserDefaults, falling back to defaultTriggerWords if not set.

methods.name: saveTriggerWords(_: defaults: UserDefaults)
methods.description: Saves an array of trigger words to UserDefaults.

methods.name: sanitizeTriggerWords(_:)
methods.description: Sanitizes an array of trigger words by trimming, filtering out empty strings, limiting number and length.

methods.name: displayString(for:)
methods.description: Creates a display string from trigger words by sanitizing and joining with commas.
